scenes.title: A vulnerability is detected
scenes.cardTitle: A fictional EC2 server needs attention
scenes.cardBody: An example finding flags an outdated package.
captions: An EC2 server has a high severity vulnerability. The security workflow captures the alert.
This is a simulated example, using fictional findings and no live AWS data.

scenes.title: AI investigates the finding
scenes.cardBody: The assistant summarizes impact and proposes a patch.
scenes.result: Proposed fix ready for human review
captions: An AI assistant checks the finding and explains the security risk in plain language.
It prepares a proposed patch and makes the reasoning visible for review.

scenes.title: A person decides
scenes.cardBody: A human checks the plan and approves this one action.
captions: Before anything changes, a person reviews the plan and approves the proposed action once.
The human approval gate keeps production changes from running automatically.

scenes.title: A patch would be applied
scenes.cardTitle: Systems Manager would run the patch
scenes.cardBody: After approval, the workflow shows a simulated action.
captions: After approval, AWS Systems Manager would apply the patch to the affected server.
This video is a simulation. No command runs and nothing is changed in AWS.

scenes.title: Close the loop with evidence
scenes.cardTitle: Verify the outcome and record it
scenes.cardBody: Capture the approval, action, and verification result.
captions: Finally, the workflow would verify the result and record evidence for the audit trail.
Detection, human approval, action, and verification stay connected and visible.
